{{Quote|But be— [garbled]—his affectation for the wardrobe of Onderon's bygone royal Magi Sentinels, I strongly believe Magnus may be one of the architects of the Arkanian Revolution.|Fragment of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] holotransmission prior to the [[Battle of Skye]]|<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
The '''Magi Sentinels''' (singular: '''Magus Sentinel''') were an organization of [[Clothing/Legends|robed]] individuals who protected the [[King/Legends|monarch]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]] in [[3998 BBY]]. They were guarding King [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin's]] [[Ommin's subterranean fortress|subterranean fortress]] when [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]] and [[Aleema Keto]] arrived for his aid in translating a [[Sith spellbook/Legends|Sith spellbook]] they had stolen.<ref name="FNU" />

By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Magi Sentinels were long gone, but the genetic abomination known as [[Zeta Magnus]] wore vestments that resembled theirs.<ref name="swcw" />

Some time later, the [[Imperial Sentinel]]s developed by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to serve his [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]]<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> also donned cloaks and armors similar to the equipments of both the Magi Sentinels and Zeta Magnus.<ref name="DE 4">[[Dark Empire 4|''Dark Empire'' 4]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So these guards seemed to me an obviously intended antecedent of some sort, even if only in spirit. Zeta Magnus thus became the missing link. I just had to name them.|[[Abel G. Peña]]|<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52238034|board=Literature|thread=Abel G. Peña's "Skyewalkers" Hits the Internet!|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2015-03-18|time=3:47 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802145257/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/abel-g-pe%C3%B1as-skyewalkers-and-lone-wolf.50027998/page-6}}</ref>}}
Onderon's Magi Sentinels first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]'', a [[1994]] sub-series of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] series of comics, written by [[Tom Veitch]]. However, they were only identified as such by [[Abel G. Peña]] in the [[EBook|eNovella]] ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]'', which was written between [[2008]] and [[2011]] but only released in [[2015]]. Peña saw the visual similarity between the unnamed guards in ''The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' and the Imperial Sentinels from Veitch's ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' as intended, and thus made the connection more explicit while describing the similarly garbed Zeta Magnus.<ref name="JCF" />
